inner_policy: Current training-only tissue-stratified grouped 3-fold RMSE selection; same as fixed-eight repeated evaluation
split_policy: Leave out one complete frozen tissue across all independent biological groups; same outer tissue split shared by all drugs and model arms

scoring.primary_contrast: response_association_pair_full minus expression_strong Spearman within each held-out tissue
scoring.primary_tissue_set: Frozen ten tissues with >=20 groups per drug, equally weighted within drug
scoring.strict_missing: Any undefined tissue contrast makes the per-drug ten-tissue mean NA; any undefined per-drug mean makes fixed eight-drug macro NA; retain defined-cell count and never nanmean the strict value
secondary: Per-drug x tissue x model metrics over all 23 tissues
paired RMSE improvement versus same-policy unseen-tissue global mean
concatenated all-LOTO OOF Spearman, labelled cross-tissue calibration-sensitive

resources.failure_policy: Preserve every completed/failed task and explicitly resume only this frozen version; no omission based on score
